predictions.match: FC Bayern Munich vs Dubai Basketball
predictions.text: Selection: Dubai Basketball to beat FC Bayern Munich (to win the game outright). The sealed inputs credit Dubai with four wins from six EuroLeague games while Bayern Munich have two from six, giving Dubai a 69.2 percent model probability at a fair -225, inside the price window but short of the 70 percent threshold; because the snapshot contains no verified injury report, travel or recent-match sequence for either club, this is published as a Low-confidence lean with the shortfall stated openly.

predictions.match: Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens vs Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz
predictions.text: Selection: Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens to beat Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz (match winner, including overtime). The sealed EuroLeague inputs credit Panathinaikos with five wins from six games against one win from six for Baskonia, which drives the model probability to 84.5 percent, yet the matching fair price of -544 falls far outside the requested -250 to +10000 window, and evidence-v1.0 remains uncalibrated with no verified player availability, so this stays a Low-confidence lean rather than a High pick despite the lopsided records.

predictions.match: Armani Olimpia Milan vs FC Barcelona
predictions.text: Selection: FC Barcelona to beat Armani Olimpia Milan (match winner under EuroLeague overtime rules). Sealed EuroLeague records show Barcelona level at three wins and three losses while Milan have managed one win from six, and the log5 calculation lands exactly on 70.0 percent, which does not satisfy a strictly greater-than-70-percent rule even though the -233 fair price sits inside the window; without verified rotation news or recent game-by-game history in the sealed snapshot, Barcelona stay a Low-confidence pick.

Selection: Boston Bruins to beat the Nashville Predators (moneyline, settled on the final result after any extra period). Boston's sealed input line is seven wins against two binary losses, with Nashville at three wins and two binary losses, and the fresh official NHL standings read at 12:01 UTC confirms Boston have taken points from nine of ten games; the model reaches 71.6 percent, agonisingly pricing at -252, two points outside the -250 window, so the Bruins are the closest miss in this desk and remain Low, not High.

predictions.match: New York Islanders vs Los Angeles Kings
predictions.text: Selection: New York Islanders to beat the Los Angeles Kings (moneyline settled after overtime or a shootout, if needed). Sealed NHL inputs show the Islanders at five wins and three binary losses while Los Angeles sit at one win and four binary losses, producing a 75.7 percent model probability; however the corresponding fair price near -311 breaches the -250 lower bound of the brief's window, and with no calibrated track record or verified lineup news in the sealed evidence, the Islanders are recorded only as a Low-confidence selection.

predictions.match: St. Louis Blues vs Vegas Golden Knights
predictions.text: Selection: Vegas Golden Knights to beat the St. Louis Blues (moneyline under NHL overtime rules). Vegas carry the strongest sealed record in this fixture at eight wins and three binary losses against four wins and four binary losses for St. Louis, yet the model probability stops at exactly 70.0 percent rather than clearing it, and a -233 price inside the window cannot compensate for uncalibrated evidence-v1.0 inputs, unverified starting goaltenders and no sealed recent-form sequence, leaving Vegas at Low confidence.

Selection: Minnesota Wild to beat the Calgary Flames (moneyline, with overtime counting toward settlement). The model's sealed records put Minnesota at six wins and two binary losses compared with Calgary at two wins and six binary losses, a gap that yields 72.7 percent, but the fair price around -267 is shorter than the -250 window allows, while Calgary's small early-season sample and the absence of verified goaltender or injury information in the snapshot mean this cannot honestly be promoted above Low confidence.

Selection: Edmonton Oilers to beat the Carolina Hurricanes (moneyline on the regulation-plus-overtime result). Both clubs arrive with elite sealed records, Edmonton at seven wins and one binary loss and Carolina at eight wins and two binary losses, which is precisely why the model can only separate them at 52.9 percent and a fair -112; this is the clearest coin-flip on the NHL slate, so Edmonton are listed as a Low-confidence nominal selection and explicitly not a value or High-confidence recommendation.

flagged.title: Zero picks satisfy BOTH >70% and the -250..+10000 window
flagged.detail: Of 22 priced selections, the five above 70% (Panathinaikos 84.5%/-544, NY Islanders 75.7%/-311, Minnesota 72.7%/-267, Boston 71.6%/-252, plus exactly-70.0% cases) all price shorter than -250 or fail strict >70%. No High pick can be issued under the brief without breaking one of its own two rules. No High was invented.

flagged.title: Exactly 70.0% is not >70%
flagged.detail: FC Barcelona (euroleague-round7-63) and Vegas Golden Knights (nhl-2026020160) both compute to 0.7000 after Beta(2,2)+log5. Treating them as >70% would be rounding fraud; they remain Low.
